verdict.rationale: Slate has a dedicated Skills doc page. It defines skills as markdown instruction packages that give the agent domain-specific knowledge and behavior, shows an example skill description, and lists skill discovery directories, including `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code compatibility. This directly covers equipping the agent with custom skills for specialized tasks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work in practice, and documented detail on how skills are invoked or selected at runtime.
